full_judgment: 44. In the premises, we are of the view that the correctness of the marks contained in the Tabulation sheets, maintained by the University authority, cannot be questioned now. The Tabulation sheets were produced by the University before this Court, attested Photostat copy of which has been kept with the records of the respective cases, show that the University authority do not take proper care in preserving the Tabulation sheets in accordance with Rules or provisions made therefore. The impugned decision for cancellation of results only on the ground that there are easements and overwriting in the petitioners' marks appearing in the Tabulation sheets, in the absence of any finding or proof that these marks are not correct, is simply based on presumption and therefore, is bad in the eye of law.
